notes.title: An update for the playtest version of the HordeCore is live!
notes.content:
Dear HordeCore lovers,

We are happy to present you an update for the playtest version of the HordeCore! Now we would like to present you a multiplayer, new UI, new game modes and lots of other cool features.

A multiplayer build is available now and you can play it with up to 4 friends at once, or solo, if you prefer. But it is definitely more fun with other people!

Please, don't forget to fulfill the survey after you try it out and share your thoughts about the game. It is very important for us as we plan to release the full game soon!

Also, please, don't forget to add HordeCore

https://store.steampowered.com/app/980210/HordeCore/

to your wishlist!
